## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused and does not change unrelated application behavior.
- [ ] Migrations, API changes, environment variables, and security implications are documented.
- [ ] Tests and documentation were updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private customer data are included.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are included for Console UI changes.
